title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.Purpose of This PositionAs a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent. You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.Core ResponsibilityServe as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions: "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"\ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"Main Objectives1. Content Execution & Copywriting Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for: -Websites -Social media captions and post copy -Email campaigns -Campaign and promotional assets Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text) Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad. Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness. Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.2. Strategy & Project Management Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring: -Consistency in writing style -Variety in content types -A range of related, engaging topics3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging. When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms. When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans. Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives. Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints. Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative. Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.5. Brand Advocacy Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content. Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution. Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.Reporting Relationship This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging. Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity. Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.2. Content Quality & Accuracy Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose. Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.3. Project Delivery Timeliness Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines. Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken EnglishReady for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Plm Architect
description: About us : ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry specific alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner. Responsibilities You will lead and/or support consulting services and implementation projects for Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) using PTC Windchill Product suite. You will analyze customers' business requirements and successfully implement solutions as part of a cross-functional team. You will lead and/or participate in, assist with, or act as the facilitator in workshops/work sessions. You will support the definition of client-specific solutions for PLM, including application and technical architecture. You will help our customers realize value faster by optimizing OOTB solutions and redefining processes, as needed. You will execute assigned project tasks for planning, analysis, development, and testing. You will execute technical tasks including the installation and configuration of PLM software, assessing gaps between requirements and software functionality and define appropriate path forward debugging, data migration, infrastructure, and deployment support. You will ensure quality through established software engineering methods and processes. You will be a valued project team contributor by demonstrating an ability to balance independent work practices with appropriate levels of communication across a broad spectrum of project stakeholders. You will manage commitments within a flexible work schedule. Knowledge and Abilities: Strong PLM domain knowledge Proven experience on delivering PLM solutions to customers Strong interpersonal skills Strong communication and presentation skills Knowledge of PTC Windchill Product suites desired. Be able to work autonomously and focus on goals. Be customer service oriented. Have programming skills, preferably in Java. A desire to continue your professional growth through formal and on-the-job ongoing product and consulting skills training. Must Have Skills 5-10+ years' experience in PLM, preferably PTC Windchill Product suite. Participated in PLM Implementation projects. Educational background in Engineering or Computer Science (bachelor's or master's Degree Level) Languages: Advanced or Fluent Proficiency level (written and spoken) in English and Spanish. Willingness to travel, as neededITC Infotech is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description: No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.Requisitos necessários Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.Diferenciais Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.#SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF

title: Ui Designer
description: About Lilo Social Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.The Role The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.What Success Looks Like Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocityResponsibilities Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practicesRequirements 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar) Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholdersNice to Have Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0 Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages) Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After EffectsCompensation and Benefits Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Sr Desenvolvimento React Native + Ia
description:

Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia. Certificada pelo 7o ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries! #VempraíliaSobre a vaga Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor React Native que não apenas construa interfaces, mas que entenda como integrar Inteligência Artificial no core do produto. O candidato ideal é um engenheiro\ "AI-First\", que utiliza ferramentas como Cursor para acelerar o desenvolvimento e possui conhecimento profundo sobre como orquestrar Agentes de IA e gerenciar contexto via MCP (Model Context Protocol). Você trabalhará diretamente com Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) em especificações técnicas precisas que alimentam fluxos de codificação assistida por IA.Responsabilidades Desenvolvimento Mobile: Arquitetar e desenvolver aplicações escaláveis em React Native (iOS/Android) com TypeScript. Integração de IA: Implementar funcionalidades que consomem LLMs, gerenciam estado de conversação e integram ferramentas externas via MCP. Fluxo AI-First: Utilizar o editor Cursor como IDE principal, dominando a composição de contextos, regras de projeto (.Cursorrules) e automação de refatoração. Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código. Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar\ "Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar). Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.Requisitos React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated). TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada. Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules). Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas. Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar). Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API. Produto: Capacidade de ler e questionar PRDs, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em especificações técnicas.Benefícios e Incentivos Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraíliaPara Saúde e bem-estar: Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica paraescalar resultadose aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção desoluções inovadorase disruptivas emmais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionaisde múltiplos segmentos.Nosso propósito éimpactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos umespaço aberto e livrepara você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas egerar mudanças ao seu redor .Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que: Contratação:CLT Modelo de Trabalho:Remoto Horário:das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.. Etapas do Processo:Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra. Meios de Comunicação:Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.O que buscamos?Estamos em busca de um/umaDesenvolvedor(a) Backend Java Sêniorpara fazer parte do nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por implementar e orquestrar microsserviços modernos, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (Kafka/RabbitMQ) assumindo entregas de ponta a ponta, da implementação ao deploy em produção. Esperamos que você encabece integrações complexas, atue no tuning avançado das aplicações e suas integrações com bancos de dados (SQL/NoSQL) e seja protagonista na adoção de tecnologias emergentes, além de criar ambientes de confiança para revisões de código de alto padrão.Como será seu dia-a-dia? Implementar e evoluir arquiteturas de aplicações de microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência e manutenibilidade ao longo do tempo;
Elaborar templates de arquitetura de aplicação de referência para o time, sempre que demandado;
Protagonizar decisões técnicas com visão de impacto, explicitando trade-offs para o time e para produto, mesmo em cenários com informações incompletas;
Garantir a estabilidadedos sistemas em produção, realizando a resposta a incidentes, definindo prioridades de correção e propondo melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrência;
Implementar e disseminar práticas de observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, APM com Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído para aumentar a previsibilidade operacional;
Conduzir code reviews de alto padrão, orientando o time em boas práticas de arquitetura, design patterns, testes e segurança;
Atuar em integrações complexas com sistemas internos e externos, aplicando padrões de resiliência como Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA;
Identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria em queries SQL, estratégias de cache e configurações de pool de conexões para otimizar a performance das aplicações;
Apoiar diretamente líderes técnicos (Tech Leads) em acordos técnicos entre squad, produto e demais áreas, traduzindo complexidade técnica em impacto de negócio de forma clara e rastreável;
Explorar e adotar tecnologias emergentes de forma responsável, avaliando custo, benefício e risco antes da incorporação no stack do time. Aprimorar continuamente os processos e práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando técnicas de uso de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar o desenvolvimento de software, de forma avançada e responsável.Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:Profundidade em Java avançado: Multithread, gerenciamento de memória/GC, Virtual Threads (Java 21) e domínio das diferenças entre versões LTS, bem como domínio total de programação funcional;
Domínio amplo de DesignPatterns com capacidade de reconhecer o momento certo de aplicá-los;
entendimento de como a Injeção de Dependência funciona internamente (Reflection/Proxies);
Experiência sólida com Spring (Boot, Data, Security) e uso de frameworks reativos;
Domínio de estratégias de resiliência em integrações: Circuit Breaker, Retry, Fallback e SAGA (ex: Resilience4j);
domínio do conceito de Idempotência;
Experiência prática e profunda com Kafka (Partições, Offsets, Consumer Groups) e RabbitMQ avançado (DLQ, Retry Policies, Exchanges);
Capacidade de realizar tuning de queries SQL, criação de índices, e estratégias de cache (local vs distribuído, TTL e invalidação);
Domínio avançado de pelo menos um banco de dados relacional e um banco NoSQL (MongoDB ou DynamoDB);
Domínio de observabilidade avançada com OpenTelemetry, pelo menos uma ferramenta de APM (Datadog/NewRelic/Dynatrace) e tracing distribuído;
Experiência prática comKubernetes. Não irá administrar diretamente, mas é necessária experiência de interpretação do ecossistema;
Experiência prática comcomponentes de pelo menos uma Cloud (AWS ou GCP) Capacidade real e experiência em Documentação como código usando Mermaid ou PlantUML através de arquivos markdown;
Domínio sólido de estratégias em pelo menos uma ferramenta de IA assistida (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity ou Claude Code), bem como experiência prática de consumo de pelo menos 1 tipo de MCP Server através destas ferramentas.Você irá se destacar se:Ser committer ativo em repositórios open-source relevantes;
Experiência em tuning avançado de integração com bancos de dados usando JPA e pool de conexões (ex: HikariCP);
Ter realizado publicações técnicas em canais relevantes (blog, artigos, palestras, conferências);
Experiência com frameworks como Apache Camel ou outros de integração de sistemas (ESB/EDA);
Experiência em arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) de alta complexidade;
Conhecimento ou experiência com bancos de dados colunares ou baseados em grafos;
Certificações Cloud (AWS ou GCP) ativas;
Implementação de API Gateways (Kong, Sensedia, AWS API Gateway) via configuração e/ou código;
Experiência em integração arquitetural de APIs de LLM (LangChain, RAG/bancos vetoriais) ou criação de soluções próprias baseadas em IA;
Capacidade de liderar migrações de monolitos para microsserviços;
Ter implementado mais de dois exemplos de servidores MCP de alta complexidade técnica.O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;

Plano de Saúde NacionalPorto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
Seguro de vida.Todas asnossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Coding Agentsto help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients. This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.What You'll Do: 1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes. Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR). Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works. Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.G., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions. Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals. Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.Who We're Looking For: 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience. Python proficiency required;
proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred. Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss. Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.2. Highly valued experience Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools. Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent). RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design. Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems. Comfort with SQL and structured data workflowsWhy Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, Multimodalto help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.What You'll Do 1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding. Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching. Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities. Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references. Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls. Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions. 3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals. Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift. When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement. 4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics. Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.Who We're Looking For 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text. Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models. Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.2. Highly valued experience RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks. Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent). Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion. Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems. Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models. Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.Required Qualifications for Consideration:8+ years of experience working in the networking space 5+ years of experience working in a TAC Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS Expertise of wireless deployments – AP's, Controllers, Client associations, etc Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark High level of English. Available Monday through Friday or 'staggered work week's, i.E. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.Why Join Us? Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next.....Come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description: In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working fromBrazil remotelyto join our team and provide high‐level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.How You'll Help Us Connect the World:You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. Available Monday through Friday or 'staggered work week's, i.E. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.Why Join Us? Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next.....Come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness packageCandidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. title: Delivery Lead
description:
Required Skills & Experience5+ years of experience in delivery lead role Experience delivering data and analytics products in a production environment Working knowledge of:
- ETL processes and data pipelines
- BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between business, product, and engineering teams Demonstrated ability to identify issues early and escalate effectivelyNice to Have Skills & ExperienceExperience supporting logistics, transportation, or pricing analytics initiatives Background working with Azure-based data ecosystems Familiarity with database backends and data modeling concepts Experience operating in complex, cross-functional enterprise environmentsJob DescriptionInsight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client's Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

title: Senior Api Engineer

Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing). Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.Required skills & experience: 7+ years building production microservices and APIs. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design. Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems. Hands-on development inTypeScriptfor backend services. Proven RESTful API design and contract experience. Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies. Strong withAWS(API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents). Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers). Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification. Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties. Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.). Good spoken EnglishNice to have: Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources. Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts). Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics. Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos). Background in personalization/experimentation systems. Hands-on development in Python for backend services.Hiring signals: Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements. Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns. Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.Perks: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team Health/Sport budget Remote work Flexible PTO Global offices Fun, positive, collaborative environment!Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.Principais Responsabilidades: Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.Requisitos e Qualificações: Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
Arquiteturas de agentesautônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.Você vai se divertir mais se: Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.Será um diferencial se você: Tiver experiência com Node.Js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
Já tiver trabalhado comRAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
Possuir experiência comAWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.Nossos benefícios: Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;
Vale Transporte;

title: Ui/Ux Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior LevelAbout the Role We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.We are looking for aUI/UX Designerwho can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.What You'll Do
- Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff
- Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions
- Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration
- Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements
- Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products
- Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership
- Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch What We're Looking ForMust-Have Experience
- 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment
- Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design
- Advanced proficiency withFigmaincluding components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping
- Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints
- Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value
- Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully definedNice to Have
- Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users
- Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals
- Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products
- Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground upHow We Work Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.What You'll Get
- Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
- Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration
- Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges
- A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Pessoa Arquiteta De Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.O DESAFIO: Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;
● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;
● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);
● Garantir aderência àsdiretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;
● Desenvolver e manter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);
● Elaborar e gerenciar artefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;
● Apoiar squads na modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;
● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;
● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;
● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;
● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;
● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;
● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);
● Trabalhar lado a ladocom líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo.O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER: ● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável) ● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos ● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrênciaBancos de Dados e Persistência ● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos) ● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade ● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready ● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal)) ● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakersSegurança e Compliance ● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS ● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia ● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)Metodologias e Governança Técnica ● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna ● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados ● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.IoMentalidade e Comportamentos ● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas ● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.Js, Python, PHP, etc ● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto ● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica ● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos) ● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínuaDIFERENCIAL: ● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ: ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Einstein Conecta: Orientação médica online com os especialistas do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito. ️Seguro de Vida: Segurança para você e quem você ama. Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para aproveitar os momentos especiais. Previdência Privada: Planeje o futuro com segurança. Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): Sucesso compartilhado com todos. Fretado das estações Barra Funda e Santana Gympass: Acesso a academias e atividades físicas para manter a saúde em dia. ️ Parceria com o SESC: Acesso a lazer e cultura com benefícios exclusivos Reset Day: 1 dia OFF por ano para aproveitar da melhor forma.Por que escolher a Dimensa? Na Dimensa, você fará parte de um time que está revolucionando o mercado de operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros, com inovação e tecnologia de ponta. Queremos conhecer você e ver como você pode contribuir para nossa missão!Junte-se a nós e faça a diferença.#VEMFAZERPARTEDAONDAVERDE
