title: Gerente De Operações Financeiras (Financial Operations Manager)
description:
Responsibilities: Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements. Liaise with accounting firms for bookkeeping, document preparation, SPED filings, and tax submissions (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS). Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal audit and legal standards. Collect and organize data for regulatory reporting to Receita Federal and the Central Bank of Brazil. Monitor tax and foreign exchange compliance risks related to stablecoin-based transactions, and escalate issues as needed. Handle foreign exchange filings and reports for cross-border crypto transactions (e.G., RDE-IED, SISCOSERV). Assist in interpreting local regulatory developments and aligning operational processes accordingly. Provide financial and operational insights to support management in budgeting and strategic planning. Support internal reporting, KPI tracking, and process documentation. Effectively utilize financial operations software, crypto custody tools, and dashboards.Requirements: 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments. Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk. Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail. Fluency in Portuguese and English;
proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.What we offer: Competitive salary and benefits. Opportunities for professional growth and development. A collaborative and innovative work environment. The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus Job type: Full TimeResponsabilidades: Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, acompanhamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins. Coordenar junto às empresas de contabilidade a escrituração, preparação de documentos, arquivos SPED e submissões fiscais (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS). Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com auditorias internas e padrões legais. Coletar e organizar dados para relatórios regulatórios à Receita Federal e ao Banco Central do Brasil. Monitorar riscos de conformidade fiscal e cambial relacionados a transações com stablecoins e escalar problemas conforme necessário. Gerenciar registros cambiais e relatórios para transações transfronteiriças de criptomoedas (ex: RDE-IED, SISCOSERV). Auxiliar na interpretação de novas regulações locais e alinhar os processos operacionais de acordo. Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico. Apoiar relatórios internos, rastreamento de KPIs e documentação de processos. Utilizar efetivamente softwares de operações financeiras, ferramentas de custódia de cripto e dashboards. Requisitos: Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3. Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional. Familiaridade com relatórios financeiros brasileiros (SPED, Receita Federal, Banco Central) e conformidade fiscal (tax compliance). Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes. Fluência em Português e Inglês;
Proficiência em Espanhole Mandarim é um diferencial. O que oferecemos: Salário e benefícios competitivos. Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional. Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador. A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

title: Coordenador De Banco De Dados

Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados. Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;
Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão e vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas;

Acompanhar, validar e medir a qualidade e saúde do ambiente de Banco de Dados. Estruturar e acompanhar os indicadores da area de Banco de Dados. Tracionar iniciativas de automação para a gestão do ambiente de Banco de Dados, reduzindo atividades operacionais e garantindo agilidade e tempo de resposta as mudanças de ambiente. Contribuir para obter um clima organizacional favorável, bem como a redução do turn over, através de ferramentas de gestão de pessoas, como contratações assertivas, comunicação interna eficaz, treinamento e desenvolvimento, reconhecimento e recompensa, buscando equipes de alta performance. Zelar pelo sigilo das informações tratadas na sua área de atuação. Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.Buscamos alguém que apresente: Experiencia em gestão de pessoas Habilidade de construir matriz de decisão, RFPs e RFIs Experiencia de gestão financeira e de contratos de infraestrutura de TI Conhecimento Avançado de banco de dados SQL Server Conhecimento de Bancos Nativos Cloud Conhecimento de banco de dados My SQL (Desejável) Conhecimento de banco de dados No SQL (Desejável) Cursos e certificações correlatas a Banco de dadosAntes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
- Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
- Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
- Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
- Planejem e executem otrabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
- Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.Informações da vaga: Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda a Sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
- Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
- Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
- Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
- Licença maternidade epaternidade estendidas;
- Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.Proteção e estabilidade: - Previdência privada;
- Participação nos lucros;
- Seguro de vida.Facilidades para o dia a dia: - Vale-Alimentação;
- Vale-Refeição;
- Vale-Transporte;
- Auxílio-Creche;
- Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.Desenvolvimento e educação: - Plataforma de ensino;
- Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. title: Product Designer
description: SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs. Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback. Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams. Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy. Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team. Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries. Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs).. Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team. Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.Required Skills 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role). Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture. A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design. Experience with Figma. Understand how modern technologies are used with design. Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked. Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas. Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements. Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work. Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem. Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniquesDesired Skills Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS. Experience with Jira and Confluence. Prior experience in a design related role at a startup. Experience with digital health or relatable areas. Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure. This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments. We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support. We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well. Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL;
DR You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to: Lead cloud migrations to OCI Design cloud architectures Automate migrations and infrastructure Coordinate DevOps engineers Talk directly to clients Help build repeatable DevOps processes You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients. English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based DevOps job If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you. This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:\ "We can automate 80% of this.\" And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI. Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation We want to automate everything that can be automated: Automated infrastructure provisioning Migration scripts CI/CD pipelines Environment replication Monitoring setups If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading DevOps Engineers As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems. You likely: Love automating infrastructure Hate manual processes Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems Are comfortable debugging production environments Enjoy designing architectures Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations Cloud Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important AWS Azure GCPDevOps Docker Kubernetes Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools CI/CD pipelines Linux systems administration Networking fundamentals Automation Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software. Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy. Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience. Fully remote work Flexible hours 22 days paid time off per year Quarterly bonus based on company performance AI allowance for productivity tools We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process Application review Technical conversation Architecture discussion Conversation(s) with one or more partners This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
TheProject Managerin our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are deliveredon time, within scope, and within budget. This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managingmultiple projectsor client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.G.,Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ). Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution:Define projectscope, objectives, and deliverablesfor cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities. Team Leadership & Coordination:Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site andremote/hybrid work environments. Budget & Risk Management:Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively;
implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.G., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution. Stakeholder Communication:Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Quality Assurance & Delivery:Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.G., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs. Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement:Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emergingindustry trends(likeAI integration in project management ,DevSecOps, and newcollaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education & Professional Knowledge:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Project Management Skills:Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects usingproject management methodologies(Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Leadership & Communication:Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinatingcross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner. Analytical & Problem-Solving:Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such ascloud computing projects, digital transformation, orAI-driven solutionsis a plus. Industry Experience:Prior experience in anIT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managingmultiple full project lifecycles, with at least several projects related toIT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. Certifications: Project Management Certifications:Project Management Professional (PMP)orPRINCE2(highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise. Security/Technical Certifications:Certifications such asCertified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) ,Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), orCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance. Agile/Other Certs:Additional certifications likeCertified Scrum Master (CSM)orITIL Foundationare beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Engenheiro(A) De Dados Sênior – Oracle Cloud
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em arquitetura, integração e processamento de dados na Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro,, integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.Responsabilidades: - Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).
- Construir e gerenciar integrações de dados via APIs REST e ingestão de arquivos (CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet) a partir de fontes heterogêneas.
- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.
- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.
- Trabalhar com processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT) respeitando a arquitetura de camadas do Data Lake.
- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.
- Garantir boas práticas de governança, qualidade e segurança de dados.
- Atuar em colaboração com times de arquitetura, analytics e áreas de negócio para entender demandas e propor soluções escaláveis.Requisitos Necessários: - Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.
- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.
- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.
- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).
- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).
- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.
- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar).Diferenciais: - Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.
- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.
- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.
- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados.Modelo de Trabalho - Remoto - Contratação PJBenefícios ATRA: - TotalPass - Reembolso 100% em certificações - Parcerias educacionais - Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas - Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de pontaSobre a ATRA Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. title: Devops Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure. This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments. We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support. We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well. Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL;
DR You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to: Lead cloud migrations to OCI Design cloud architectures Automate migrations and infrastructure Coordinate DevOps engineers Talk directly to clients Help build repeatable DevOps processes You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients. English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based DevOps job If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you. This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:\ "We can automate 80% of this.\" And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI. Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation We want to automate everything that can be automated: Automated infrastructure provisioning Migration scripts CI/CD pipelines Environment replication Monitoring setups If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading DevOps Engineers As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems. You likely: Love automating infrastructure Hate manual processes Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems Are comfortable debugging production environments Enjoy designing architectures Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations Cloud Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important AWS Azure GCPDevOps Docker Kubernetes Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools CI/CD pipelines Linux systems administration Networking fundamentals Automation Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software. Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy. Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience. Fully remote work Flexible hours 22 days paid time off per year Quarterly bonus based on company performance AI allowance for productivity tools We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process Application review Technical conversation Architecture discussion Conversation(s) with one or more partners This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.
